_comment: The detector-residual ratchet for this surface: the statically-erased or renamed forms DELIBERATELY outside the corpus contract, per rule — known limits of precise, low-false-positive detection, recorded as data so a rule's page states where its detection ends instead of leaving it to guesswork. The list only shrinks: closing a residual means seeding the corpus case that contracts it and deleting the entry here, never silently. Every key is a catalog rule id of this surface, and the keys are sorted; held by tests/architecture/test_rule_standard.py.

frontend/generated-client-only: egress through receivers other than `window`/`globalThis` (`self.fetch`) is not required
frontend/no-dom-html-injection: a computed sink (`el["innerHTML"] = ...`) is not required to be recognised
frontend/no-eval: a computed global (`window["eval"]`) is not required to be recognised
frontend/no-framework-markers: an attribute name that is not a literal (`element.setAttribute(name, value)`, a computed key `{ [name]: value }`) is not required to be resolved to a marker

a marker written by a route other than an attribute in markup, a properties-object key, an attribute-setting call or a data-attribute-map assignment (`Object.assign(element.dataset, { terp: "card" })`, an attribute node built with `document.createAttribute`) is not required to be recognised
frontend/timestamp-inputs-carry-their-of: a type reached through a spread or a variable (`type={kind}`), and an input whose type is set through the DOM rather than in JSX, are not resolved to the local date-and-time control
